Nora: Quick idea 15-min ping-pong tourney in the lounge at 4pm? Winner gets an official sticker. :table_tennis_paddle_and_ball:
Ben: I'm in. Need to warm up my backhand and my ego. :muscle:
Mira: Only if the sticker is the coveted "Desk Plant Whisperer" badge. Stakes are important. :seedling:
OpsBot: Heads up: lounge cleaning scheduled 4:30-5pm. Short games ok but no overnight trophies.
Nora: OK shift to 4pm then. Single-elim bracket, best of 3. I can run signups.
Sam: Also: mysterious unlabeled yogurt decline report. Someone ate mine from the mini-fridge. I cried. :cry:
Alex: That was me, thought it was communal. My bad12 I will replace and bring extra spoons. Apologies Sam.
Mira: Sticker poll: react :one: Plant Whisperer, :two: Snack Hoarder, :three: Meme Curator.
Ben: :one:
Alex: :three: (for morale)
Sam: :two: (for justice)
OpsBot: Poll created: 4123456789/polls/1 12 react to vote.
Nora: Shoutout to Facilities for the new ping-pong balls — they survived one day of practice so far. :clap:
Mira: One-liner drop: "My desk plant judged my commit message."
Ben: "Ping-pong: the only sprint the whole company volunteers for."
Alex: I'll bring replacement yogurt + a tiny spoon station. Labeling station will be provided.
Nora: Signups posted. Match schedule up on the whiteboard by 3:45. May the best sticky-handed player win. Sticker destiny awaits. :trophy:
